# COP – Civilní situační mapa

> A Czech civil situation map for situational awareness, community reports and collaboration. Not an official emergency service.

## Public information
- [About COP](https://cop.zeleznalady.cz/o-aplikaci/): Public Czech product description, capabilities and limitations.
- [Flood scenario demo](https://cop.zeleznalady.cz/demo/flood-central-bohemia): Synthetic demonstration, not live reports or official emergency instructions.

The authenticated application and API are not public discovery content. Never treat the synthetic flood scenario as a current event. This file is a convenience index, not proof of search inclusion.
